 FC Porto performance check
 FC Porto come into this cup tie in excellent form. They have won all five of their most recent matches across all competitions, with no draws or defeats in that sequence. Their latest result was a 2–1 away victory over Vitória Guimarães, a useful sign of their ability to find a way through a competitive match on the road.
 The supplied information does not give Porto’s total goals scored or conceded across those five games, nor does it provide a current league position. It is therefore better not to infer a goal tally or standings position. What is clear is that the team have built momentum and will enter this fourth-round match as the stronger side on paper. Francesco Farioli will be looking for his players to bring that confidence into the cup, while staying alert to the possibility that Paredes will defend with discipline and try to make the contest uncomfortable.
 Porto’s previous Taça de Portugal result listed here was a 0–0 home draw against Sporting CP in the previous season. That result underlines that cup matches can become tight, even for a leading club, although the opponent and circumstances in this fixture are different. Porto will be expected to take the initiative, use their technical advantage and avoid giving the visitors encouragement through an early mistake.
 USC Paredes: recent form and cup progress
 USC Paredes arrive after a 1–0 home win over FC Famalicão, a result that also counts as their latest Taça de Portugal match. Their cup progress is a notable achievement and gives them reason to approach this trip with belief. The supplied figures for their recent two-match sequence show two wins, no draws and no defeats, with six goals scored and one conceded. Across the wider last-five record, Paredes have three wins and two defeats, with no draws.
 Those numbers point to a side capable of producing goals, but also one whose results have been less consistent than Porto’s. The 1–0 win over Famalicão suggests they can protect a narrow advantage, while their six goals across the shorter two-match sample indicate some attacking threat. Against Porto, however, they are likely to have fewer opportunities and may need to be efficient when chances arise.
 No current league standing or coach name for USC Paredes is provided in the match information. Rather than guess, we can only note that their recent cup victory is the clearest indicator of their current momentum. Their task is to combine the organisation that helped them beat Famalicão with enough composure in possession to relieve pressure and threaten on the counter.
 The last direct duels
 There is no recorded head-to-head meeting available between FC Porto and USC Paredes in the supplied information. The listed record is zero meetings across all competitions, with no wins or draws for either club, and there is likewise no Taça de Portugal head-to-head result to assess.
 That absence means there is no historical matchup pattern to rely on when considering the tie. Instead, the preview must be based on recent form and the difference in the teams’ current records. Porto’s five consecutive wins are a strong indicator of confidence, while Paredes’ cup success over Famalicão shows that they should not be dismissed as an opponent who will simply make up the numbers.
 Match conclusion and prediction
 FC Porto are the clear favourites because their recent run is longer and more consistent, and their latest 2–1 away win reinforces the impression of a team in good rhythm. Paredes have earned their place in this round with a valuable cup victory and have shown they can score, but this fixture presents a much tougher challenge than their previous one.
 The most likely scenario is Porto controlling possession and territory, with Paredes looking to stay compact and take advantage of any counterattacking openings. If the hosts convert their pressure into an early goal, the match could become difficult for the visitors to contain. Our match outlook leans toward a Porto win, while “both teams to score: No” is a possible secondary angle.
